title: UI review fixes
summary: Layout and wording fixes from the UI review: Spike no longer covers tables on smaller screens, and admin labels use their proper names.
changes: On tablets and phones, Spike's tip now sits at the end of the page instead of floating over tables and forms.
Plugin settings pages leave room below the last row so the Save settings bar never hides it.
Admin overview shows identity types and access classes with their normal names, such as Local, Cloudron OIDC, Volunteer and Student.
Admin permission groups use real module names, such as APES CIC · Cases.
The Consultations list shows a friendly message when there is nothing to show yet.
version_rationale: Patch: layout and wording fixes only. Routes, permissions and stored data are unchanged.
validation: UiReviewFixesTest for the empty state, labels, permission groups and layout rules.
Admin, access, layout, consultation and localisation test files locally, and the full PHPUnit suite in CI.
Manual check in the local preview at 1280, 840 and 630 pixels wide.
known_limitations: On wide screens Spike still floats in the corner, with space reserved at the bottom of each page.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. No database change is involved.
